test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

He said, "I may go there.”

options.text: He said that he would go there.
He said that he goes there.
He said that he might go there
He said that he may go there.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that he might go there.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"may" becomes "might" in indirect speech:**
 
 
• The modal verb "may" in direct
